reviewNotes: Twenty-five specialist keyboard, mouse, controller-option, tool-ready, and item-recovery strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover terminal-key meanings, internationally fixed key identifiers, mouse terminology, controller feedback, toolbar behavior, placeholders, singular and stacked recovery messages, punctuation, and natural character voice; both found no remaining objective issue.

EnlW.preservationReason: EnlW is a fixed legacy hardware-key identifier without a Romanian equivalent.
